      have h10 : (1 : ℝ) = (0 : ℝ) := by 
        exact h h9
      linarith 
    · -- Case where f 1 - 1 = 0
      linarith

    intro x 
    have h6 := h2 x (-x)
    simp [h3] at h6 
    have h7 : f (-x) = - f x := by linarith 
    exact h7
  
  have h6 : ∀ x > 0, f x > 0 := by

        linarith
